POLICIES

Privacy Notice

Last updated November 19, 2026 · Version 1.0

Brewer Family Companies (“we,” “us”) runs brewerfamilycompanies.com (the “Site”), a family-history site about Jim Brewer and the Brewer family in Bricktown, Oklahoma City. This notice explains what information the Site handles and why.

The short version

  • We do not use analytics, advertising pixels or tracking cookies on the Site.
  • We do not sell or share personal information for advertising.
  • The public Site has no accounts, forms or checkout.

Information our service providers receive

When your browser loads the Site, our hosting provider (GitHub Pages) and our database provider (Supabase) receive standard technical information, such as your IP address, browser type and the page requested. They use it to deliver the Site and keep it secure. We do not combine it with other information to identify you.

Email you send us

If you email us, we keep your message and email address so we can reply and keep a record of corrections and requests.

Private team workspace

The “Team access” area is a private workspace for approved members only. It uses an approved member’s email address to send one-time sign-in links. It is not open to the public, and it does not accept new sign-ups.

Video and links to other sites

The archive video is played from YouTube in privacy-enhanced mode. YouTube may receive technical information when the player loads and may set cookies if you play the video. Google’s Privacy Policy applies to YouTube. Links to news archives and to our companies’ websites take you to sites with their own privacy policies.

Children

The Site is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Your requests

To ask what information we hold about you, or to ask us to correct or delete it, email brett@brewerfamilycompanies.com. We will respond within 45 days.

Changes

If we change how the Site handles information, we will update this notice and the date above.

Questions? Email brett@brewerfamilycompanies.com.
